clusters.canonical_title: Object.assign mutates shared DEFAULT_OPTIONS, leaking prefs across requests
clusters.canonical_description: applyOptions mutates the module-level DEFAULT_OPTIONS via Object.assign, so one request's preferences pollute the defaults seen by later callers; devin observed the downstream symptom in the trip route.
clusters.match_rationale: One flags the mutation site, the other its downstream symptom; both trace to the same shared-object mutation.
clusters.single_fix: Clone DEFAULT_OPTIONS (spread or structuredClone) before merging user options in applyOptions().

clusters.canonical_title: Missing null check on req.user in profile handler
clusters.canonical_description: Unauthenticated requests reach the profile handler and crash accessing req.user.id.

clusters.canonical_title: Missing null check on order.customer for guest checkouts
clusters.canonical_description: order.customer can be null for guest checkouts; notifyOrder throws on .email.

clusters.canonical_title: syncAll has no error handling; failures leave partial state
clusters.canonical_description: syncAll performs awaited pushes with no try/catch, retry, or rollback — any rejection (e.g. the unhandled await push() at line 103) kills the loop and leaves partial state.
clusters.match_rationale: bugbot's unhandled await is a concrete instance of devin's function-level missing-error-handling finding.
clusters.single_fix: Wrap syncAll's awaited calls (including push() at line 103) in try/catch with rollback or retry of partial state.

clusters.canonical_title: Off-by-one in page slice drops the last item of every page
clusters.canonical_description: The slice end index start + pageSize - 1 excludes the final element, returning pageSize-1 items per page. Bugbot re-reported the same defect on a second review pass.
clusters.match_rationale: Same reviewer re-reported the identical slice off-by-one across review passes.
clusters.single_fix: Change the slice end index to start + pageSize in page().

clusters.canonical_title: SQL injection via string interpolation in findByName
clusters.canonical_description: name is interpolated directly into a raw SQL string; use a parameterized query.
